scope: Single-page graphical abstract (problem -> method -> core result -> conclusion) built from the case materials; editable layered source plus PNG/PDF exports, with per-element provenance.

evidence.claim: Title: Mitochondrial ROS relay stabilises HIF-1alpha and reprograms substrate use in hypoxic cardiomyocytes

source.quote: Title: Mitochondrial ROS relay stabilises HIF-1alpha and reprograms substrate use in hypoxic cardiomyocytes

evidence.claim: Cardiomyocytes exposed to ischaemia face a fall in oxygen availability.

source.quote: Cardiomyocytes exposed to ischaemia face a fall in oxygen availability.

evidence.claim: Mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) rise within minutes of hypoxia and have been proposed to act as a signalling relay rather than only as damage.

source.quote: Mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) rise within minutes of hypoxia and have been proposed to act as a signalling relay rather than only as damage.

evidence.claim: Whether that relay is what stabilises HIF-1alpha, and how the cell keeps ATP supply while glucose oxidation is suppressed, remains unresolved.

source.quote: Whether that relay is what stabilises HIF-1alpha, and how the cell keeps ATP supply while glucose oxidation is suppressed, remains unresolved.

evidence.claim: H9c2 cardiomyoblasts were exposed to 1% O2 for 24 h (hypoxia) or 21% O2 (normoxia).

source.quote: H9c2 cardiomyoblasts were exposed to 1% O2 for 24 h (hypoxia) or 21% O2 (normoxia).

evidence.claim: Mitochondrial ROS were measured with MitoSOX.

source.quote: Mitochondrial ROS were measured with MitoSOX.

evidence.claim: HIF-1alpha protein was quantified by immunoblot.

source.quote: HIF-1alpha protein was quantified by immunoblot.

evidence.claim: Transcripts were measured by RT-qPCR.

source.quote: Transcripts were measured by RT-qPCR.

evidence.claim: Substrate use was resolved with a Seahorse assay using glucose or palmitate.

source.quote: Substrate use was resolved with a Seahorse assay using glucose or palmitate.

evidence.claim: ATP content was normalised to total protein.

source.quote: ATP content was normalised to total protein.

evidence.claim: HIF-1alpha and NRF2 were knocked down with siRNA.

source.quote: HIF-1alpha and NRF2 were knocked down with siRNA.

evidence.claim: Hypoxia raised mitochondrial ROS 2.8-fold (MitoSOX, normoxia 1.0) and stabilised HIF-1alpha protein 3.4-fold.

source.quote: Hypoxia raised mitochondrial ROS 2.8-fold (MitoSOX, normoxia 1.0) and stabilised HIF-1alpha protein 3.4-fold.

evidence.claim: HIF-1alpha knockdown abolished the rise in LDHA mRNA (4.1-fold in hypoxia, 1.1-fold after knockdown) and in PDK1 mRNA (2.6-fold, 1.0-fold), showing that LDHA and PDK1 transcription is HIF-1alpha dependent.

source.quote: HIF-1alpha knockdown abolished the rise in LDHA mRNA (4.1-fold in hypoxia, 1.1-fold after knockdown) and in PDK1 mRNA (2.6-fold, 1.0-fold), showing that LDHA and PDK1 transcription is HIF-1alpha dependent.

evidence.claim: PDK1 phosphorylated PDH at Ser293 3.1-fold, and PDH catalytic activity fell from 0.42 to 0.19 per second.

source.quote: PDK1 phosphorylated PDH at Ser293 3.1-fold, and PDH catalytic activity fell from 0.42 to 0.19 per second.

evidence.claim: Glucose-supported oxygen consumption fell from 42.3 to 23.8 pmol per minute, while palmitate-supported oxygen consumption rose from 11.6 to 34.2 pmol per minute;

source.quote: Glucose-supported oxygen consumption fell from 42.3 to 23.8 pmol per minute, while palmitate-supported oxygen consumption rose from 11.6 to 34.2 pmol per minute;

evidence.claim: total oxygen consumption was therefore maintained (53.9 to 58.0 pmol per minute).

source.quote: total oxygen consumption was therefore maintained (53.9 to 58.0 pmol per minute).

evidence.claim: ATP content fell modestly, from 18.7 to 12.4 nanomoles per milligram of protein.

source.quote: ATP content fell modestly, from 18.7 to 12.4 nanomoles per milligram of protein.

evidence.claim: Extracellular acidification rate rose from 12.4 to 31.8 milli-pH units per minute, consistent with increased glycolytic flux.

source.quote: Extracellular acidification rate rose from 12.4 to 31.8 milli-pH units per minute, consistent with increased glycolytic flux.

evidence.claim: NRF2 nuclear translocation increased 3.2-fold and its targets NQO1 and HMOX1 rose 2.9-fold and 2.4-fold.

source.quote: NRF2 nuclear translocation increased 3.2-fold and its targets NQO1 and HMOX1 rose 2.9-fold and 2.4-fold.

evidence.claim: NRF2 knockdown raised mitochondrial ROS further, from 2.8-fold to 4.6-fold, and combined HIF-1alpha plus NRF2 knockdown reduced viability from 92 percent to 54 percent.

source.quote: NRF2 knockdown raised mitochondrial ROS further, from 2.8-fold to 4.6-fold, and combined HIF-1alpha plus NRF2 knockdown reduced viability from 92 percent to 54 percent.

evidence.claim: Mitochondrial ROS act upstream of HIF-1alpha in hypoxic cardiomyocytes.

source.quote: Mitochondrial ROS act upstream of HIF-1alpha in hypoxic cardiomyocytes.

evidence.claim: The HIF-1alpha-PDK1 arm suppresses glucose oxidation without collapsing total oxygen consumption, because fatty acid oxidation compensates.

source.quote: The HIF-1alpha-PDK1 arm suppresses glucose oxidation without collapsing total oxygen consumption, because fatty acid oxidation compensates.

evidence.claim: NRF2 restrains the ROS signal, and losing both arms together costs viability.

source.quote: NRF2 restrains the ROS signal, and losing both arms together costs viability.

evidence.claim: Mitochondrial ROS relay in hypoxic cardiomyocytes.

source.quote: Mitochondrial ROS relay in hypoxic cardiomyocytes.

evidence.claim: Hypoxia increases mitochondrial ROS, which stabilises HIF-1alpha.

source.quote: Hypoxia increases mitochondrial ROS, which stabilises HIF-1alpha.

evidence.claim: HIF-1alpha drives LDHA and PDK1;

source.quote: HIF-1alpha drives LDHA and PDK1;

evidence.claim: PDK1 phosphorylates PDH at Ser293 and lowers PDH activity, suppressing glucose-supported oxygen consumption while palmitate-supported oxygen consumption rises, so total oxygen consumption is maintained.

source.quote: PDK1 phosphorylates PDH at Ser293 and lowers PDH activity, suppressing glucose-supported oxygen consumption while palmitate-supported oxygen consumption rises, so total oxygen consumption is maintained.

evidence.claim: NRF2 translocates to the nucleus and induces NQO1 and HMOX1, which restrain ROS.

source.quote: NRF2 translocates to the nucleus and induces NQO1 and HMOX1, which restrain ROS.

evidence.claim: Combined loss of HIF-1alpha and NRF2 reduces viability.

source.quote: Combined loss of HIF-1alpha and NRF2 reduces viability.
